description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended zanidatamab, within its marketing authorisation, to treat HER2-positive (IHC3-positive) unresectable locally advanced or metastatic biliary tract cancer in adults after at least 1 line of systemic treatment. Zanidatamab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
